response.overview: Bruno and Valerie are two young people in a casual, sexually intimate relationship based on trust. Throughout their relationship, they openly discuss their romantic interests and their uncertain futures. While Valerie offers Bruno a space where he can be heard and supported, he struggles with doubts about what kind of relationship he should prioritize. Their bond blurs the boundaries of their self-discovery, as their story unfolds amid the streets, suburban hotels, and the historic center of Lima.
